prompt: Use case: historical-scene. ONE square detailed painterly naturalistic encyclopedia illustration of Nuribotoke, Japanese animated-corpse yokai. Choose the Edo scroll form with black hair trailing from its back, NOT the debated catfish-tail variant. One uncanny humanlike corpse with pitch-black lacquer-dark skin, thin human arms and legs, and BOTH eyeballs drooping far below their empty-looking eye sockets on thin dark attachments, clearly outside their normal positions. No blood, torn flesh or graphic injury: treat dangling eyes as established supernatural anatomy in a tasteful folklore illustration. Long coarse black hair falls behind its head and down its back, plain worn dark cloth covers lower body modestly. It crouches at the open doors of a neglected household butsudan Buddhist altar at night, looming out of shadow. Truly disturbing eerie corpse-spirit aura with mischievous menace, dim cold candle-side light that reveals shiny black skin and pale dangling eyes. Central complete humanlike creature comfortably inside frame, realistic painterly materials. Invariants: pitch-dark animated corpse, visibly dangling eyeballs, source-selected back-hair variant, household altar setting. Avoid ordinary in-socket eyes, catfish tail, horns, wings, fangs, missing limbs, gore, severed parts, nudity, sacred Buddha statue confusion, readable sutra writing, extra people, text, watermark, collage, border.
visual_requirements: Both eyeballs clearly dangling below sockets
Disturbing eerie corpse-spirit menace without gore
depicted_variant: Edo scroll black back-hair form; not debated catfish-tail form

visual_review.notes: Observed one humanlike thin corpse with shiny pitch-black skin, two pale eyeballs visibly dangling on dark attachments below empty-looking sockets, long coarse black hair trailing down back, lower body covered by ragged cloth. It crouches beside open butsudan in deep candlelit shadow, producing clear disturbing horror. No catfish tail, horns, wings, blood, torn flesh, visible genitals, weapon, text or watermark.
